project.name: Pulse Retention Engine SaaS
project.description: Autonomous AI-Native Retention Analytics & Client Reporting Platform

cases.title: Shopify Webhook Ingestion & HMAC Verification
cases.description: Verifies that incoming orders/create webhooks are validated with sha256 HMAC and deduplicated in Redis via 24h TTL idempotency.

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/webhooks/shopify/:tenantId/:clientId with valid HMAC header

cases.title: Recharge Subscription Isolation
cases.description: Verifies that recurring subscription charges are flagged with is_subscription: true.

steps.expected_result: Event normalized into ClickHouse with channel: 'subscription' and is_subscription: 1

cases.title: True Contribution Margin vs. Gross ESP Claims
cases.description: Verifies that refunds, discounts, and subscription renewals are deducted from ESP claims.

steps.expected_result: discrepancyPercentage and netContributionMargin correctly isolated from raw gross

cases.title: Flow Decay Anomaly Detection (Z-Score < -1.8)
cases.description: Verifies that automations experiencing CTR or RPR drop beyond 1.8 sigma trigger decay alerts.

cases.title: Discount Cannibalization Margin Loss
cases.description: Verifies that unneeded discounts given to organic high-intent buyers are accurately estimated.

cases.title: Deliverability Radar Apple MPP Filtering
cases.description: Verifies that Apple Mail Privacy ghost opens are subtracted from raw open rates.

cases.title: Stripe Multi-Tenant Tier Enforcement
cases.description: Verifies that Starter, Growth, and Scale plans enforce store and event allowances.
